sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
# Move DOWN to r25-28 to collect red
result = action(['DOWN'])
print(f"DOWN: bc={result.get('board_changed')}, done={result.get('done')}")

seg = current_frame.segmentation
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
        b = n['boundary']
        rows = [p[0] for p in b]
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if min(rows) < 50:
            print(f"  {n['color']}: r{min(rows)}-{max(rows)}, c{min(cols)}-{max(cols)}")

# Now extend RIGHT to touch red
# Green is on bridge, red is at c24-27
# Need to extend bridge to c24-27
# Let's check bridge position first
for n in seg['nodes']:
    if n['color'] in ['w', 'g'] and n['pixels'] <= 4:
        b = n['boundary']
        cols = [p[1] for p in b]
        if 16 <= min(cols) <= 46 and min([p[0] for p in b]) >= 19:
            print(f"  Bridge tip: c{max(cols)}")
            break

# Extend RIGHT to touch red at c24-27
for i in range(4):
    result = action(['RIGHT'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    blocks = []
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ['R', 'b', 'N'] and n['pixels'] == 16:
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            if min(rows) < 50:
                blocks.append((n['color'], min(rows), max(rows), min(cols), max(cols)))
    print(f"  RIGHT {i+1}: blocks={blocks}")
    if result.get('done'):
        print("LEVEL COMPLETE!")
        break

</function>
</tool_call>
